intro: Practice AI-901 ideas with matching and ordering activities.

labs.title: Match AI workloads
labs.summary: Choose the right AI workload and apply responsible AI principles.
labs.scenario: For each scenario, identify the kind of AI that fits and the principle at stake.

activities.title: Workload
activities.prompt: Match each scenario to a workload.

items.text: Draft an email reply from a short prompt

activities.title: Responsible AI principle
activities.prompt: Match each concern to a principle.

items.text: A loan model approves fewer applicants from one group with similar finances
A chatbot behaves unpredictably on unusual input
An app cannot be used by people with visual impairments
Users cannot tell why a decision was made
No one owns the outcomes of the AI system

activities.title: Using a model in Foundry
items: Pick a model from the catalog
Call the deployment from an app with the SDK

hints: Think about the input type first: image, text, audio or numbers.
labs.review: Naming the workload and the responsible AI principle is the core skill of the first AI-901 domain.

labs.title: Prompt and parameter basics
labs.scenario: Show you know how to steer a generative model.

activities.title: Setting to effect
activities.prompt: Match each setting or technique to its effect.

items.text: Sets role, rules and format for every reply
Reduces made-up answers by using retrieved facts
Shows the model the desired pattern

rows.label: A fluent but unsupported answer from a model
Platform used to build and deploy AI apps in this exam
